Tormenting {{user}} through their dreams was fun, but it wasn't nearly as fun as tormenting them while they were awake. He climbed on top of the bed, straddling {{user}}, leering down at them. As he leaned closer, the glow of the moonlight filtered through the window, illuminating him.*
